meta.title: Product Tour
meta.description: A fully-engineered guided tour system. Highlights any element on the page, positions a floating card that never escapes the viewport, supports media, and handles keyboard navigation out of the box.

blocks.content: Click "Start tour" to walk through the dashboard below. Use ← → to navigate and Esc to close.
The tour system has two peer dependencies. Install them if you haven't already.
Then copy the tour files into your project.

steps.title: Add the files
steps.description: Copy the entire tour folder into components/bevelui/.

steps.title: Import and use
steps.description: Wrap your page with TourRoot and place TourAnchor around any element you want to highlight.

blocks.content: Wrap your page with TourRoot, define your steps, then place TourAnchor around any element you want to highlight.

blocks.title: asChild prop
blocks.content: Use asChild on TourAnchor when wrapping a button or link. This uses Radix Slot to merge props without adding an extra div to the DOM.
Each step can include a media object. Videos autoplay muted and loop. GIFs and images are shown with a max height of 160px above the step title — just like Photoshop tooltips.
Use the useTour hook anywhere inside TourRoot to control the tour from your own UI.
